World model (revised — breakthrough):
- Two-click (item → socket interior) **did change the board**: green key shrank from 5-wide to 2-wide (lost right 3 columns), and its r-dot moved from col 31 to col 28 (left edge of body). G tab (left anchor) unchanged. +9 black cells.
- So the mechanic involves a two-click sequence that "chops" the key; amount/cause of the 3-column chop is unclear.
- Red plus at (10,52) shares the green key's row; plus at (52,10) shares the yellow key's column — likely goal markers.
- Plan: controlled repeat — click key (10,28) then same socket (21,39); measure new chop to infer the rule (fixed 3? click-relative?).
